task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should companies let staff choose their own laptop and phone? Give at least two reasons and one real example.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：公司应该让员工自己选笔记本电脑和手机吗？给出至少两个理由和一个真实的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: in an IT career, is it better to go deep in one technology or to know a little about many? Give at least two reasons and an example from your own work.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：在 IT 职业中，深入钻研一种技术更好，还是多种技术都懂一点更好？给出至少两个理由和一个你工作中的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should tipping become normal in New Zealand cafés and restaurants? Give at least two reasons and one real example.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：在新西兰的咖啡馆和餐厅给小费应该成为常态吗？给出至少两个理由和一个真实的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should people keep a dog if they live in a small flat? Give at least two reasons and an example of someone you know.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：住在小公寓里的人应该养狗吗？给出至少两个理由和一个你认识的人的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: is it better to cook a big batch of food on Sunday or to cook fresh every day? Give at least two reasons and one real example.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：周日一次做好一大批饭菜更好，还是每天做新鲜的更好？给出至少两个理由和一个真实的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should primary school children get homework? Give at least two reasons and an example from your own childhood.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：小学生应该有家庭作业吗？给出至少两个理由和一个你小时候的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should there be an extra tax on sugary drinks? Give at least two reasons and one real example.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：应该对含糖饮料额外征税吗？给出至少两个理由和一个真实的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: is it worth buying a new phone every two years? Give at least two reasons and an example from your own life.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：每两年换一部新手机值得吗？给出至少两个理由和一个你自己生活中的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: are open-plan offices a good idea? Give at least two reasons and an example from a place you have worked.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：开放式办公室是个好主意吗？给出至少两个理由和一个你工作过的地方的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: are team-building days really useful? Give at least two reasons and one real example.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：团建活动真的有用吗？给出至少两个理由和一个真实的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: is it better to travel alone or with friends? Give at least two reasons and an example from a trip you took.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：一个人旅行好，还是和朋友一起旅行好？给出至少两个理由和一个你旅行时的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should the age for getting the pension in New Zealand go up from 65? Give at least two reasons and one real example.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：新西兰领取养老金的年龄应该从 65 岁往上调吗？给出至少两个理由和一个真实的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should every adult have to learn first aid? Give at least two reasons and one real example.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：每个成年人都应该学急救吗？给出至少两个理由和一个真实的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: is "buy now, pay later" a good way to shop? Give at least two reasons and one real example.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：“先买后付”是一种好的购物方式吗？给出至少两个理由和一个真实的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: are top sports stars paid too much? Give at least two reasons and the example of one player you know about.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：顶级运动明星的收入太高了吗？给出至少两个理由，并举一个你了解的运动员为例。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should phones be banned at the dinner table at home? Give at least two reasons and an example from your own family.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：在家吃晚饭时应该禁止用手机吗？给出至少两个理由和一个你家里的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: is it rude to arrive ten minutes late to a friend's party? Give at least two reasons and one real example.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：去朋友的聚会迟到十分钟算不算没礼貌？给出至少两个理由和一个真实的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should guests take off their shoes when they visit your home? Give at least two reasons and an example from different cultures.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：客人来你家时应该脱鞋吗？给出至少两个理由和一个不同文化的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should every code change be reviewed by another person, even a one-line fix? Give at least two reasons and an example from your own work.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：每一处代码改动，哪怕只改一行，都应该由别人审查吗？给出至少两个理由和一个你工作中的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should New Zealand cities build more tall apartment buildings? Give at least two reasons and one real example.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：新西兰的城市应该多建高层公寓楼吗？给出至少两个理由和一个真实的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: is it better to live close to work in a small flat or far away in a big house? Give at least two reasons and one real example.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：住在离公司近的小公寓好，还是住在离公司远的大房子好？给出至少两个理由和一个真实的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: is it a good idea to be close friends with your manager? Give at least two reasons and one real example.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：和自己的经理成为好朋友是个好主意吗？给出至少两个理由和一个真实的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should children's sports games keep score? Give at least two reasons and one real example.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：儿童体育比赛应该记分吗？给出至少两个理由和一个真实的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: can you trust online reviews when you choose a restaurant or a product? Give at least two reasons and an example from your own experience.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：选餐厅或商品时，网上的评价可信吗？给出至少两个理由和一个你亲身经历的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should cafés ask people with laptops to leave when it gets busy? Give at least two reasons and one real example.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：咖啡馆在客人多的时候应该请用笔记本电脑的人离开吗？给出至少两个理由和一个真实的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: does everyone need a side hustle these days? Give at least two reasons and an example of someone you know.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：如今每个人都需要一份副业吗？给出至少两个理由和一个你认识的人的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: is it better to pay off your mortgage early or to invest the money? Give at least two reasons and one real example.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：提前还清房贷更好，还是把钱拿去投资更好？给出至少两个理由和一个真实的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should companies be able to see what staff do on their work computers? Give at least two reasons and one real example.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：公司应该能查看员工在工作电脑上做了什么吗？给出至少两个理由和一个真实的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should New Zealand keep daylight saving time? Give at least two reasons and an example from your own routine.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：新西兰应该保留夏令时吗？给出至少两个理由和一个你日常作息中的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should employers look at job applicants' social media before hiring them? Give at least two reasons and one real example.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：雇主在招人之前应该查看求职者的社交媒体吗？给出至少两个理由和一个真实的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should supermarkets stop selling drinks in plastic bottles? Give at least two reasons and one real example.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：超市应该停止销售塑料瓶装饮料吗？给出至少两个理由和一个真实的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: is a big wedding worth the money? Give at least two reasons and an example of a wedding you went to.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：办一场盛大的婚礼值得花那么多钱吗？给出至少两个理由和一个你参加过的婚礼的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should parents limit how much time teenagers spend on video games? Give at least two reasons and one real example.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：父母应该限制青少年玩电子游戏的时间吗？给出至少两个理由和一个真实的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: do you need a university degree to do well in IT? Give at least two reasons and an example of someone you have worked with.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：要在 IT 行业做得好，一定需要大学学位吗？给出至少两个理由和一个你共事过的人的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should apps be allowed to track where you are all the time? Give at least two reasons and an example of an app you use.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：应该允许应用一直追踪你的位置吗？给出至少两个理由，并举一个你用的应用为例。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should dogs be allowed on every beach? Give at least two reasons and an example from a beach you know.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：应该允许狗去所有的海滩吗？给出至少两个理由，并举一个你熟悉的海滩为例。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should restaurants print the calories of each dish on their menus? Give at least two reasons and one real example.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：餐厅应该在菜单上标出每道菜的卡路里吗？给出至少两个理由和一个真实的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: is camping a real holiday, or just hard work in a different place? Give at least two reasons and one real example.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：露营算真正的度假吗，还是只是换个地方受累？给出至少两个理由和一个真实的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should colleagues tell each other how much they earn? Give at least two reasons and one real example.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：同事之间应该互相透露自己的工资吗？给出至少两个理由和一个真实的例子。

task: Speak for 2–3 minutes and give your opinion: should everyone who lives in New Zealand learn some te reo Māori? Give at least two reasons and an example from your daily life.
zh: 讲 2–3 分钟，说说你的观点：住在新西兰的每个人都应该学一些毛利语吗？给出至少两个理由和一个你日常生活中的例子。
